Rails.application.routes.draw do
  devise_for :users, path: "", path_names: {
    sign_up: "registration",
    sign_in: "login"
  }, controllers: {
    registrations: "registrations",
    sessions: "sessions"
  }
  mount Rswag::Ui::Engine => "/api-docs"
  mount Rswag::Api::Engine => "/api-docs"
  get "home/index"
  get "home/test_icons"
  # Define your application routes per the DSL in https://guides.rubyonrails.org/routing.html

  # Reveal health status on /up that returns 200 if the app boots with no exceptions, otherwise 500.
  # Can be used by load balancers and uptime monitors to verify that the app is live.
  get "up" => "rails/health#show", as: :rails_health_check

  # Render dynamic PWA files from app/views/pwa/* (remember to link manifest in application.html.erb)
  # get "manifest" => "rails/pwa#manifest", as: :pwa_manifest
  # get "service-worker" => "rails/pwa#service_worker", as: :pwa_service_worker

  # Web routes
  root "home#index"

  # Authentication routes (handled by Devise)

  # Phone authentication
  post "/phone_login", to: "auth#phone_send_otp"
  get "/phone_verify", to: "auth#phone_verify_form"
  post "/phone_verify", to: "auth#phone_verify_otp"

  # Google OAuth (main web authentication)
  get "/auth/:provider/callback", to: "auth#google_callback"

  delete "/logout", to: "auth#logout"

  # Home page (authenticated users)
  get "/home", to: "home#index"

  # Dashboard routes
  get "/dashboard", to: "dashboard#index"

  # Public Sport Classes Routes (RESTful)
  resources :sport_classes, only: [ :index, :show ], path: "sport-classes", param: :slug

  # Profile setup after registration and email verification
  namespace :registration do
    get "/setup", to: "profile_setup#show"
    patch "/setup", to: "profile_setup#update"

    # Email verification for admin/organizer accounts
    get "/verify-email/:token", to: "auth#verify_email", as: "verify_email"
  end

  # Profile Management Routes
  namespace :profiles do
    get "/", to: "management#edit"
    patch "/", to: "management#update"

    # Profile visibility and settings
    get "/settings", to: "management#settings"
    patch "/settings", to: "management#update_settings"

    # Preview public profile
    get "/preview", to: "management#preview"

    # Testimonials management
    resources :testimonials, only: [ :index, :show, :update, :destroy ] do
      member do
        patch :approve
        patch :reject
        patch :feature
        patch :unfeature
      end
    end
  end

  # Role-specific routes
  namespace :member do
    get "/", to: "dashboard#index", as: "dashboard"
    get "/classes", to: "sport_classes#index"
    get "/classes/:id", to: "sport_classes#show", as: "class"
    post "/classes/:id/join", to: "memberships#create", as: "classes_join"
    post "/classes/:id/add_child", to: "memberships#add_child", as: "classes_add_child"
    get "/schedule", to: "schedules#index"
    post "/clock_in/:schedule_id", to: "clock_ins#create", as: "clock_in"
    patch "/clock_out/:id", to: "clock_ins#update", as: "clock_out"
    post "/report_absence/:schedule_id", to: "clock_ins#report_absence", as: "report_absence"
    resources :performances, only: [ :index ]

    # Member profile routes
    get "/profile", to: "profiles#show", as: "profile"
    get "/profile/edit", to: "profiles#edit", as: "edit_profile"
    patch "/profile", to: "profiles#update", as: "update_profile"

    # Member invitation acceptance routes
    get "/invitations/:token", to: "invitations#show", as: "invitation"
    get "/invitations/:token/register", to: "invitations#register", as: "register_invitation"
    post "/invitations/:token/accept", to: "invitations#accept", as: "accept_invitation"

    # Children management routes
    resources :children do
      resources :documents, controller: "child_documents", only: [ :create, :show, :destroy ]
    end
  end

  namespace :owner do
    get "/", to: "dashboard#index", as: "dashboard"

    # Owner profile routes
    get "/profile", to: "profiles#show", as: "profile"
    get "/profile/edit", to: "profiles#edit", as: "edit_profile"
    patch "/profile", to: "profiles#update", as: "update_profile"
    get "/profile/preview", to: "profiles#preview", as: "profile_preview"

    resources :memberships, only: [ :index ] # General memberships index for all owner's sport classes
    resources :performances, only: [ :index ] # General performances index for all owner's sport classes
    resources :coaches, only: [ :index ] # General coaches index for all owner's sport classes
    resources :sport_classes do
      resources :coaches do
        member do
          post :resend
        end
      end
      resources :memberships do
        collection do
          get :search_users
          post :add_existing_member
        end
        member do
          patch :activate
          patch :trial_to_active
        end
      end
      resources :member_invitations, only: [ :index, :new, :create ]
      resources :performances
    end
    resources :schedules do
      member do
        get :cancel_confirmation
      end
    end
    resources :events # RESTful events management for owners
    resources :event_registrations, only: [ :index, :show, :update ]
  end

  namespace :coach do
    get "/", to: "dashboard#index", as: "dashboard"
    resources :sport_classes, only: [ :index, :show ] # View assigned sport classes
    resources :memberships, only: [ :index, :show, :update ] # Manage members in assigned classes
    resources :performances # Manage member performances
    resources :schedules, only: [ :index, :show ] # View schedules

    # Coach invitation acceptance
    get "/invitations/:token", to: "invitations#show", as: "invitation"
    post "/invitations/:token/accept", to: "invitations#accept", as: "accept_invitation"
    post "/invitations/:token/decline", to: "invitations#decline", as: "decline_invitation"
    get "/invitations/:token/register", to: "invitations#register", as: "register_from_invitation"
    post "/invitations/:token/create_account", to: "invitations#create_account"
  end

  # Removed event_organizer namespace - functionality moved to admin namespace

  # Public profile routes (SEO-friendly public profiles)
  get "/coach/:slug", to: "public_profiles#coach", as: "public_coach_profile"
  get "/owner/:slug", to: "public_profiles#owner", as: "public_organizer_profile"

  # API routes
  namespace :api do
    namespace :v1 do
      # Authentication routes
      scope "/auth" do
        post "/google", to: "auth#google_callback"
        post "/phone/send_otp", to: "auth#phone_send_otp"
        post "/phone/verify_otp", to: "auth#phone_verify_otp"
        post "/refresh", to: "auth#refresh_token"
        get "/profile", to: "auth#profile"
        delete "/logout", to: "auth#logout"
      end

      # Add your other API endpoints here
    end
  end

  # Legacy OAuth callback (if needed for different flow)
  # get '/auth/:provider/callback', to: 'sessions#omniauth_callback'
end

class SessionsController < Devise::SessionsController
  before_action :check_if_already_signed_in, only: [ :new ]

  def new
    super
  end

  def create
    # First check if user exists
    user = User.find_by(email: params[:user][:email])

    if user.nil?
      flash[:alert] = "Email tidak ditemukan."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if user has the right roles (owner or coach only)
    unless user.owner? || user.coach?
      flash[:alert] = "Akses ditolak. Hanya pemilik kelas dan pelatih yang dapat masuk melalui halaman ini."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if email is confirmed (for Devise confirmable)
    unless user.confirmed?
      flash[:alert] = "Akun belum diverifikasi. Silakan periksa email untuk konfirmasi akun."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if email is verified (custom field)
    unless user.email_verified?
      flash[:alert] = "Email belum diverifikasi. Silakan verifikasi email terlebih dahulu."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path and return
    end

    # Proceed with normal Devise authentication
    self.resource = warden.authenticate!(auth_options)
    if resource
      flash[:notice] = "Berhasil masuk."
      sign_in(resource_name, resource)
      respond_with resource, location: after_sign_in_path_for(resource)
    else
      flash[:alert] = "Email atau password salah."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path
    end
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Login error: #{e.message}"
    flash[:alert] = "Terjadi kesalahan saat masuk. Silakan coba lagi."
    redirect_to new_user_session_path
  end

  # For web-based OAuth callback (optional) - keeping existing functionality
  def omniauth_callback
    auth_hash = request.env["omniauth.auth"]

    if auth_hash
      user = User.find_or_create_by_google_oauth(auth_hash)
      session[:user_id] = user.id
      redirect_to root_path, notice: "Successfully signed in with Google!"
    else
      redirect_to root_path, alert: "There was an error signing in with Google."
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "OAuth callback error: #{e.message}"
    redirect_to root_path, alert: "There was an error during authentication."
  end

  protected

  def after_sign_in_path_for(resource)
    if resource.owner?
      owner_dashboard_path
    elsif resource.coach?
      coach_dashboard_path
    else

class Member::DashboardController < ApplicationController
  before_action :require_member

  def index
    @memberships = current_user.memberships.includes(:sport_class).current
    @trial_memberships = current_user.trial_memberships.includes(:sport_class)
    @upcoming_schedules = upcoming_schedules_for_user
    @recent_clock_ins = current_user.clock_ins.includes(schedule: :sport_class).recent.limit(5)
    @performance_summary = current_user.performance_summary
  end

  private

  def upcoming_schedules_for_user
    today = Date.current
    current_day = today.wday

    user_sport_classes = current_user.sport_classes_as_member

    Schedule.joins(:sport_class)
            .where(sport_class: user_sport_classes)
            .active
            .where(day_of_week: current_day)
            .includes(:sport_class)
            .order(:start_time)
  end
end

class ApplicationController < ActionController::Base
  # Only allow modern browsers supporting webp images, web push, badges, import maps, CSS nesting, and CSS :has.
  allow_browser versions: :modern

  protect_from_forgery with: :exception

  # Devise provides current_user, user_signed_in?, and authenticate_user! methods
  # So we only need to add our custom helper methods

  helper_method :avatar_initial

  def require_authentication
    authenticate_user!
  end

  def require_role(role)
    authenticate_user!

    unless current_user.has_role?(role)
      redirect_to root_path, alert: "Akses ditolak"
    end
  end

  def require_member
    require_role(:member)
  end

  def require_owner
    require_role(:owner)
  end

  def require_coach
    require_role(:coach)
  end

  def avatar_initial(user)
    return "" unless user
    user.first_name.first.upcase
  end
end

class Member::SessionsController < Devise::SessionsController
  layout "auth"
  before_action :check_if_already_signed_in, only: [:new]

  def new
    super
  end

  def create
    # First check if user exists
    user = User.find_by(email: params[:user][:email])

    if user.nil?
      flash[:alert] = "Email tidak ditemukan. Silakan daftar terlebih dahulu."
      redirect_to new_member_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if user has member role
    unless user.member?
      flash[:alert] = "Akses ditolak. Hanya member yang dapat masuk melalui halaman ini."
      redirect_to new_member_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if email is confirmed (for Devise confirmable)
    if user.respond_to?(:confirmed?) && !user.confirmed?
      flash[:alert] = "Akun belum diverifikasi. Silakan periksa email untuk konfirmasi akun."
      redirect_to new_member_session_path and return
    end

    # Proceed with normal Devise authentication
    self.resource = warden.authenticate!(auth_options)
    if resource
      flash[:notice] = "Selamat datang kembali, #{resource.first_name}!"
      sign_in(resource_name, resource)
      respond_with resource, location: after_sign_in_path_for(resource)
    else
      flash[:alert] = "Email atau password salah."
      redirect_to new_member_session_path
    end
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Member login error: #{e.message}"
    Rails.logger.error e.backtrace.join("\n")
    flash[:alert] = "Terjadi kesalahan saat masuk. Silakan coba lagi."
    redirect_to new_member_session_path
  end

  protected

  def after_sign_in_path_for(resource)
    member_dashboard_path
  end

  def after_sign_out_path_for(resource_or_scope)
    root_path
  end

  private

  def check_if_already_signed_in
    if user_signed_in?
      redirect_to after_sign_in_path_for(current_user)
    end
  end

  def auth_options
    { scope: resource_name, recall: "#{controller_path}#new" }
  end
end

class SessionsController < Devise::SessionsController
  before_action :check_if_already_signed_in, only: [ :new ]

  def new
    super
  end

  def create
    # First check if user exists
    user = User.find_by(email: params[:user][:email])

    if user.nil?
      flash[:alert] = "Email tidak ditemukan."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if user has the right roles (owner or coach only)
    unless user.owner? || user.coach?
      flash[:alert] = "Akses ditolak. Hanya pemilik kelas dan pelatih yang dapat masuk melalui halaman ini."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if email is confirmed (for Devise confirmable)
    unless user.confirmed?
      flash[:alert] = "Akun belum diverifikasi. Silakan periksa email untuk konfirmasi akun."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if email is verified (custom field)
    unless user.email_verified?
      flash[:alert] = "Email belum diverifikasi. Silakan verifikasi email terlebih dahulu."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path and return
    end

    # Proceed with normal Devise authentication
    self.resource = warden.authenticate!(auth_options)
    if resource
      flash[:notice] = "Berhasil masuk."
      sign_in(resource_name, resource)
      respond_with resource, location: after_sign_in_path_for(resource)
    else
      flash[:alert] = "Email atau password salah."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path
    end
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Login error: #{e.message}"
    flash[:alert] = "Terjadi kesalahan saat masuk. Silakan coba lagi."
    redirect_to new_user_session_path
  end

  # For web-based OAuth callback (optional) - keeping existing functionality
  def omniauth_callback
    auth_hash = request.env["omniauth.auth"]

    if auth_hash
      user = User.find_or_create_by_google_oauth(auth_hash)
      session[:user_id] = user.id
      redirect_to root_path, notice: "Successfully signed in with Google!"
    else
      redirect_to root_path, alert: "There was an error signing in with Google."
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "OAuth callback error: #{e.message}"
    redirect_to root_path, alert: "There was an error during authentication."
  end

  protected

  def after_sign_in_path_for(resource)
    if resource.owner?
      owner_dashboard_path
    elsif resource.coach?
      coach_dashboard_path
    else
      # Fallback (should not reach here due to role validation)
      root_path
    end
  end

  def after_sign_out_path_for(resource_or_scope)
    root_path
  end

  private

  def check_if_already_signed_in
    if user_signed_in?
      redirect_to after_sign_in_path_for(current_user)
    end
  end

  def auth_options
    { scope: resource_name, recall: "#{controller_path}#new" }
  end
end

require "rails_helper"

RSpec.describe "Member::Sessions", type: :request do
  include_context "user contexts"

  let(:member_password) { "Password123!" }
  let!(:member_user) do
    create(:user, :member, :verified,
           email: "member@example.com",
           password: member_password,
           password_confirmation: member_password)
  end

  describe "GET /member/login" do
    context "when not signed in" do
      it "shows the member login page" do
        get member_login_path
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)
        expect(response.body).to include("Masuk Sebagai Member")
        expect(response.body).to include("Area Member")
      end
    end

    context "when already signed in as member" do
      before { sign_in member_user }

      it "redirects to member dashboard" do
        get member_login_path
        expect(response).to redirect_to(member_dashboard_path)
      end
    end

    context "when signed in as owner" do
      before { sign_in owner }

      it "redirects to owner dashboard" do
        get member_login_path
        expect(response).to redirect_to(owner_dashboard_path)
      end
    end
  end

  describe "POST /member/login" do
    context "with valid credentials" do
      it "signs in the member and redirects to member dashboard" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: member_user.email,
            password: member_password
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(member_dashboard_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Selamat datang kembali")
      end

      it "creates a user session" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: member_user.email,
            password: member_password
          }
        }

        expect(controller.current_user).to eq(member_user)
      end
    end

    context "with invalid credentials" do
      it "shows error for non-existent email" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: "nonexistent@example.com",
            password: "password"
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_member_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Email tidak ditemukan")
      end

      it "shows error for incorrect password" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: member_user.email,
            password: "wrongpassword"
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_member_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Email atau password salah")
      end
    end

    context "when user is not a member" do
      let!(:owner_only) do
        create(:user, :owner, :verified,
               email: "owner@example.com",
               password: member_password,
               password_confirmation: member_password)
      end

      before do
        # Remove member role if exists
        owner_only.remove_role(:member) if owner_only.has_role?(:member)
      end

      it "denies access for owner-only users" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: owner_only.email,
            password: member_password
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_member_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Akses ditolak")
      end
    end

    context "when user email is not confirmed" do
      let!(:unconfirmed_member) do
        create(:user,
               email: "unconfirmed@example.com",
               password: member_password,
               password_confirmation: member_password,
               confirmed_at: nil)
      end

      before do
        unconfirmed_member.add_role(:member)
      end

      it "shows confirmation required message" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: unconfirmed_member.email,
            password: member_password
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_member_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Akun belum diverifikasi")
      end
    end

    context "with remember me option" do
      it "remembers the member when checked" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: member_user.email,
            password: member_password,
            remember_me: "1"
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(member_dashboard_path)
        expect(response.cookies["remember_user_token"]).to be_present
      end
    end
  end

  describe "DELETE /member/logout" do
    before { sign_in member_user }

    it "signs out the member" do
      delete member_logout_path

      expect(controller.current_user).to be_nil
    end

    it "redirects to root path" do
      delete member_logout_path

      expect(response).to redirect_to(root_path)
    end
  end

  describe "member authentication flow" do
    it "allows member to access member dashboard after login" do
      # Login
      post member_login_path, params: {
        user: {
          email: member_user.email,
          password: member_password
        }
      }

      # Access dashboard
      get member_dashboard_path
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)
    end

    it "prevents unauthenticated access to member dashboard" do
      get member_dashboard_path
      expect(response).to redirect_to(new_user_session_path)
    end
  end
end

        expect(response.body).to match(/Invalid|invalid|Email atau password|tidak valid|salah/i)

          user: {
            email: '',

      # Check that we're logged out by trying to access a protected page
      get owner_dashboard_path
      expect(response).to redirect_to(new_user_session_path)
    end
  end

  describe "remember me functionality" do
    it "sets remember me when checkbox is checked" do
      post user_session_path, params: {
        user: {
          email: owner_user.email,
          password: 'password123',
          remember_me: '1'
        }
      }

      expect(response).to redirect_to(owner_dashboard_path)
      # Check if remember token is set in cookies
      expect(response.cookies['remember_user_token']).to be_present
    end
  end

  describe "email confirmation and verification sync" do
    context "when user confirms email through Devise" do
      let(:unconfirmed_user) { create(:user, :owner, :unconfirmed, email: 'newowner@test.com', password: 'password123') }

      it "automatically sets email_verified to true upon confirmation" do
        expect(unconfirmed_user.confirmed?).to eq(false)
        expect(unconfirmed_user.email_verified).to eq(false)

        # Simulate email confirmation
        unconfirmed_user.confirm

        expect(unconfirmed_user.confirmed?).to eq(true)
        expect(unconfirmed_user.email_verified).to eq(true)
      end

      it "allows login after confirmation" do
        unconfirmed_user.confirm

        post user_session_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: unconfirmed_user.email,
            password: 'password123'
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(owner_dashboard_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Berhasil masuk")
      end
    end

    context "edge case: confirmed but not email_verified" do
      let(:edge_case_user) { create(:user, :coach, email: 'edge@test.com', password: 'password123', confirmed_at: Time.current, email_verified: false) }

      it "denies login even when confirmed if email_verified is false" do
        post user_session_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: edge_case_user.email,
            password: 'password123'
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_user_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(flash[:alert]).to eq("Email belum diverifikasi. Silakan verifikasi email terlebih dahulu.")
      end

      it "allows login after manually setting email_verified" do
        edge_case_user.update(email_verified: true)

        post user_session_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: edge_case_user.email,
            password: 'password123'
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(coach_dashboard_path)
      end
    end
  end
end

class SessionsController < Devise::SessionsController
  before_action :check_if_already_signed_in, only: [ :new ]

  def new
    super
  end

  def create
    # First check if user exists
    user = User.find_by(email: params[:user][:email])

    if user.nil?
      flash[:alert] = "Email tidak ditemukan."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path and return
    end

    # Redirect members to member login page
    if user.member? && !user.owner? && !user.coach?
      flash[:alert] = "Silakan gunakan halaman login member."
      redirect_to member_login_path and return
    end

    # Check if user has the right roles (owner or coach only)
    unless user.owner? || user.coach?
      flash[:alert] = "Akses ditolak. Hanya pemilik kelas dan pelatih yang dapat masuk melalui halaman ini."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if email is confirmed (for Devise confirmable)
    unless user.confirmed?
      flash[:alert] = "Akun belum diverifikasi. Silakan periksa email untuk konfirmasi akun."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if email is verified (custom field)
    unless user.email_verified?
      flash[:alert] = "Email belum diverifikasi. Silakan verifikasi email terlebih dahulu."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path and return
    end

    # Proceed with normal Devise authentication
    self.resource = warden.authenticate!(auth_options)
    if resource
      flash[:notice] = "Berhasil masuk."
      sign_in(resource_name, resource)
      respond_with resource, location: after_sign_in_path_for(resource)
    else
      flash[:alert] = "Email atau password salah."
      redirect_to new_user_session_path
    end
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Login error: #{e.message}"
    flash[:alert] = "Terjadi kesalahan saat masuk. Silakan coba lagi."
    redirect_to new_user_session_path
  end

  # For web-based OAuth callback (optional) - keeping existing functionality
  def omniauth_callback
    auth_hash = request.env["omniauth.auth"]

    if auth_hash
      user = User.find_or_create_by_google_oauth(auth_hash)
      session[:user_id] = user.id
      redirect_to root_path, notice: "Successfully signed in with Google!"
    else
      redirect_to root_path, alert: "There was an error signing in with Google."
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.error "OAuth callback error: #{e.message}"
    redirect_to root_path, alert: "There was an error during authentication."
  end

  protected

  def after_sign_in_path_for(resource)
    if resource.owner?
      owner_dashboard_path
    elsif resource.coach?
      coach_dashboard_path
    else
      # Fallback (should not reach here due to role validation)
      root_path
    end
  end

  def after_sign_out_path_for(resource_or_scope)
    root_path
  end

  private

  def check_if_already_signed_in
    if user_signed_in?
      redirect_to after_sign_in_path_for(current_user)
    end
  end

  def auth_options
    { scope: resource_name, recall: "#{controller_path}#new" }
  end

require "rails_helper"

RSpec.describe "Member::Sessions", type: :request do
  include_context "user contexts"

  let(:member_password) { "Password123!" }
  let!(:member_user) do
    create(:user, :member, :verified,
           email: "member@example.com",
           password: member_password,
           password_confirmation: member_password)
  end

  describe "GET /member/login" do
    context "when not signed in" do
      it "shows the member login page" do
        get member_login_path
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)
        expect(response.body).to include("Masuk Sebagai Member")
        expect(response.body).to include("Area Member")
      end
    end

    context "when already signed in as member" do
      before { sign_in member_user }

      it "redirects to member dashboard" do
        get member_login_path
        expect(response).to redirect_to(member_dashboard_path)
      end
    end

    context "when signed in as owner" do
      before { sign_in owner }

      it "redirects to owner dashboard" do
        get member_login_path
        expect(response).to redirect_to(owner_dashboard_path)
      end
    end
  end

  describe "POST /member/login" do
    context "with valid credentials" do
      it "signs in the member and redirects to member dashboard" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: member_user.email,
            password: member_password
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(member_dashboard_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Selamat datang kembali")
      end

      it "creates a user session" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: member_user.email,
            password: member_password
          }
        }

        expect(controller.current_user).to eq(member_user)
      end
    end

    context "with invalid credentials" do
      it "shows error for non-existent email" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: "nonexistent@example.com",
            password: "password"
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_member_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Email tidak ditemukan")
      end

      it "shows error for incorrect password" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: member_user.email,
            password: "wrongpassword"
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_member_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Email atau password salah")
      end
    end

    context "when user is not a member" do
      let!(:owner_only) do
        create(:user, :owner, :verified,
               email: "owner@example.com",
               password: member_password,
               password_confirmation: member_password)
      end

      before do
        # Remove member role if exists
        owner_only.remove_role(:member) if owner_only.has_role?(:member)
      end

      it "denies access for owner-only users" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: owner_only.email,
            password: member_password
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_member_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Akses ditolak")
      end
    end

    context "when user email is not confirmed" do
      let!(:unconfirmed_member) do
        create(:user,
               email: "unconfirmed@example.com",
               password: member_password,
               password_confirmation: member_password,
               confirmed_at: nil)
      end

      before do
        unconfirmed_member.add_role(:member)
      end

      it "shows confirmation required message" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: unconfirmed_member.email,
            password: member_password
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_member_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Akun belum diverifikasi")
      end
    end

    context "with remember me option" do
      it "remembers the member when checked" do
        post member_login_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: member_user.email,
            password: member_password,
            remember_me: "1"
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(member_dashboard_path)
        expect(response.cookies["remember_user_token"]).to be_present
      end
    end
  end

  describe "DELETE /member/logout" do
    before { sign_in member_user }

    it "signs out the member" do
      delete member_logout_path

      expect(controller.current_user).to be_nil
    end

    it "redirects to root path" do
      delete member_logout_path

      expect(response).to redirect_to(root_path)
    end
  end

  describe "member authentication flow" do
    it "allows member to access member dashboard after login" do
      # Login
      post member_login_path, params: {
        user: {
          email: member_user.email,
          password: member_password
        }
      }

      # Access dashboard
      get member_dashboard_path
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)
    end

    it "prevents unauthenticated access to member dashboard" do
      get member_dashboard_path
      expect(response).to redirect_to(new_user_session_path)
    end
  end
end

  end

  describe "GET /member/login" do
    context "when not signed in" do
      it "shows the member login page" do
        get member_new_session_path
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)
        expect(response.body).to include("Masuk Sebagai Member")
        expect(response.body).to include("Area Member")
      end
    end

    context "when already signed in as member" do
      before { sign_in member_user }

      it "redirects to member dashboard" do
        get member_new_session_path
        expect(response).to redirect_to(member_dashboard_path)
      end
    end

    context "when signed in as owner" do
      let!(:owner_user) { create(:user, :owner, :verified) }
      before { sign_in owner_user }

      it "redirects to owner dashboard" do
        get member_new_session_path
        expect(response).to redirect_to(owner_dashboard_path)
      end
    end
  end

  describe "POST /member/login" do
    context "with valid credentials" do
      it "signs in the member and redirects to member dashboard" do
        post member_session_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: member_user.email,
            password: member_password
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(member_dashboard_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Selamat datang kembali")
      end

      it "creates a user session" do
        post member_session_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: member_user.email,
            password: member_password
          }
        }

        expect(controller.current_user).to eq(member_user)
      end
    end

    context "with invalid credentials" do
      it "shows error for non-existent email" do
        post member_session_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: "nonexistent@example.com",
            password: "password"
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(member_new_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Email tidak ditemukan")
      end

      it "shows error for incorrect password" do
        post member_session_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: member_user.email,
            password: "wrongpassword"
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(member_new_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Email atau password salah")
      end
    end

    context "when user is not a member" do
      let!(:owner_only) do
        create(:user, :owner, :verified,
               email: "owner@example.com",
               password: member_password,
               password_confirmation: member_password)
      end

      before do
        # Remove member role if exists
        owner_only.remove_role(:member) if owner_only.has_role?(:member)
      end

      it "denies access for owner-only users" do
        post member_session_path, params: {
          user: {
            email: owner_only.email,
            password: member_password
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(member_new_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Akses ditolak")
      end
    end

      let!(:unconfirmed_member) do
        create(:user,
               email: "unconfirmed@example.com",
               password: member_password,
               password_confirmation: member_password,
               confirmed_at: nil)
      end

      before do
        unconfirmed_member.add_role(:member)
      end

          user: {
            email: unconfirmed_member.email,
            password: member_password
          }
        }

        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Akun belum diverifikasi")
      end
    end

            password: member_password,
            remember_me: "1"
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(member_dashboard_path)
        expect(response.cookies["remember_user_token"]).to be_present
      end
    end
  end

      delete member_logout_path

    end

    end

          password: member_password
        }

      get member_dashboard_path
      expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)
    end

    it "prevents unauthenticated access to member dashboard" do
      get member_dashboard_path
      expect(response).to redirect_to(new_user_session_path)
    end
  end
end

class Member::SessionsController < Devise::SessionsController
  layout "auth"
  before_action :check_if_already_signed_in, only: [:new]

  def new
    super
  end

  def create
    # First check if user exists
    user = User.find_by(email: params[:user][:email])

    if user.nil?
      flash[:alert] = "Email tidak ditemukan. Silakan daftar terlebih dahulu."
      redirect_to new_member_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if user has member role
    unless user.member?
      flash[:alert] = "Akses ditolak. Hanya member yang dapat masuk melalui halaman ini."
      redirect_to new_member_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if email is confirmed (for Devise confirmable)
    if user.respond_to?(:confirmed?) && !user.confirmed?
      flash[:alert] = "Akun belum diverifikasi. Silakan periksa email untuk konfirmasi akun."
      redirect_to new_member_session_path and return
    end

    # Proceed with normal Devise authentication
    self.resource = warden.authenticate!(auth_options)
    if resource
      flash[:notice] = "Selamat datang kembali, #{resource.first_name}!"
      sign_in(resource_name, resource)
      respond_with resource, location: after_sign_in_path_for(resource)
    else
      flash[:alert] = "Email atau password salah."
      redirect_to new_member_session_path
    end
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Member login error: #{e.message}"
    Rails.logger.error e.backtrace.join("\n")
    flash[:alert] = "Terjadi kesalahan saat masuk. Silakan coba lagi."
    redirect_to new_member_session_path
  end

  protected

  def after_sign_in_path_for(resource)
    member_dashboard_path
  end

  def after_sign_out_path_for(resource_or_scope)
    root_path
  end

  private

  def check_if_already_signed_in
    if user_signed_in?
      redirect_to after_sign_in_path_for(current_user)
    end
  end

  def auth_options
    { scope: resource_name, recall: "#{controller_path}#new" }
  end
end

class Member::SessionsController < Devise::SessionsController
  layout "auth"
  before_action :check_if_already_signed_in, only: [:new]

  def new
    super
  end

  def create
    # First check if user exists
    user = User.find_by(email: params[:user][:email])

    if user.nil?
      flash[:alert] = "Email tidak ditemukan. Silakan daftar terlebih dahulu."
      redirect_to member_new_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if user has member role
    unless user.member?
      flash[:alert] = "Akses ditolak. Hanya member yang dapat masuk melalui halaman ini."
      redirect_to member_new_session_path and return
    end

    # Check if email is confirmed (for Devise confirmable)
    if user.respond_to?(:confirmed?) && !user.confirmed?
      flash[:alert] = "Akun belum diverifikasi. Silakan periksa email untuk konfirmasi akun."
      redirect_to member_new_session_path and return
    end

    # Proceed with normal Devise authentication
    self.resource = warden.authenticate!(auth_options)
    if resource
      flash[:notice] = "Selamat datang kembali, #{resource.first_name}!"
      sign_in(resource_name, resource)
      respond_with resource, location: after_sign_in_path_for(resource)
    else
      flash[:alert] = "Email atau password salah."
      redirect_to member_new_session_path
    end
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.error "Member login error: #{e.message}"
    Rails.logger.error e.backtrace.join("\n")
    flash[:alert] = "Terjadi kesalahan saat masuk. Silakan coba lagi."
    redirect_to member_new_session_path
  end

  protected

  def after_sign_in_path_for(resource)
    member_dashboard_path
  end

  def after_sign_out_path_for(resource_or_scope)
    root_path
  end

  private

  def check_if_already_signed_in
    if user_signed_in?
      redirect_to after_sign_in_path_for(current_user)
    end
  end

  def auth_options
    { scope: resource_name, recall: "#{controller_path}#new" }
  end
end
